chapter: City bands, Mississippi and baseball trips
title: Playing in Mississippi towns
summary: He played in Harrisburg, Biloxi and other Mississippi towns, with a Dude and Foster trio mentioned.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: He, uh, did you ever travel out in the country much? Huh? Did you ever travel after you came to the city? Did you go to Mississippi? When we were in the country?
Have you ever been to Mississippi and places like that?
Oh, I tell you the truth. I can tell you a place I've been in Mississippi. Did you play in Harris Boyd?
I play in Harris Boyd, Mississippi.

That's Mississippi. Look, I play Harris Boyd, Mississippi. I play in, we play, no we just, we didn't play in Slidell. I went to Slidell, we didn't play in Slidell. We played in Biloxi, Pasch Christian, Pasch Boer, all them place. Whose band was that? All them place there. We play. I used to play with a boy out there going over in Mississippi. Mostly there was two brothers. One named Dude, they had a trumpet player, the other one named Foster. Trombone player, both of them died.
Oh, I knew him, he used to work with Joe Avery.
Yeah, he used to work with Till. Avery and Tillman up at the Towers Beer Garden.
That's it. You see that? You know all them, all them, all them, all the truth.
I was down in the Navy about twelve years ago, and I used to go up there and hear him, and he sounded good, you know. I even have a record, he made a homemade record.
